'''Cole Fardreamer''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] mechanic from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Biography==
He aspired to become a great hero of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] like [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. When Cole was on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] Skywalker was known to be the best land speeder racer in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. But this dream was lost when he found out on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that Skywalker's successes were most likely due to his abilities with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. So he stayed on Coruscant as a mechanic for the New Republic fleet.<ref name="Rebellion" />

He was best known for discovering a flaw in the upgraded [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] computers, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] ordered in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], which involved bombs that were activated when the X-Wings activated, and for his role in helping the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] foil the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Kueller]]'s plot to overthrow the New Republic. He took the droids to [[Telti/Legends|Telti]], where he was captured and tortured by [[Brakiss]]. He was rescued when R2-D2 led a [[Droid uprising on Telti|rebellion]] of junked droids.<ref name="Rebellion" />
